preconditions.description: The number of parts is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of ropes is between 0 and 2000, inclusive.
The energy value of each part is between 0 and 100000, inclusive.
Each part is numbered from 1 to n.
No rope links a part to itself.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(energy_cost_for_removal(part) for part in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the minimum energy cost to remove each part.
